title: CERT 41/53 UI-FP-008..UI-FP-022 (15 rows) - row-bound re-certification
how_serving_build_was_established: The task-named oracle (port 8031, PID 33368) is GONE: curl to http://127.0.0.1:8031/live-copy returns 000 and netstat shows zero listeners on 8031; tasklist for PID 33368 reports 'No tasks are running'. The serving build was therefore re-established from the same commit rather than assumed: `git archive 89b3bc7 _archive/hl_stage2` extracted to work/src89, sha256sum of its _archive/hl_stage2/HL_Copy_App_SSOT.py = 658ec8e31eb96d70acc15dc30860334c23612d2e3e9d19fb63ed9ec4e6fa86c2 (byte-identical to the SSOT hash cited in the schema file), and git log -1 --format=%cI 89b3bc7 = 2026-10-17T07:18:14Z. Two isolated instances were launched from that tree (ports 8131/8132) with process start 2026-10-19T05:26Z, which is AFTER the commit date, so the arithmetic check passes: the commit predates the process.
oracle: Differential two-fixture oracle with no import of HL_Copy_App_SSOT.py. Two audit directories were seeded with the SAME schema and DIFFERENT values (iso_A vs iso_B) for the exact source field of each row, then two independent instances of the same build were rendered headless and the DOM compared. A row only PASSes if the rendered cell changes when its own source field changes and keeps the other rows' values distinct - i.e. the assertion would FAIL for a different row. Expected values for the Real Account cards are recomputed independently from the raw fixture inputs (sum(signed_size * mark_px) for exposure) rather than read back from the app.
